title: Contract for administrative services.
bodyText: The director may contract with a professional testing service that is qualified to test the competency of nurse aides. The department may require that fees for services be paid directly to the professional testing service.
bodyHtml: [§457A-4]  Contract for administrative services.  The director may contract with a professional testing service that is qualified to test the competency of nurse aides.  The department may require that fees for services be paid directly to the professional testing service. [L 1990, c 271, pt of §1]
